accuracy: The readout names the class of the nearest 2-degree node, which can be up to about 1.4 degrees of arc from the point tapped.
adaptations: Every second node of each 1-degree grid (a 2-degree grid) sorted into the ten elevation classes of Scotese's Table 2 (after Ziegler et al. 1985) and stored as one byte per node; the elevations themselves are not shipped.
cite: Scotese, C.R. & Wright, N.M., 2018. PALEOMAP Paleodigital Elevation Models (PaleoDEMS) for the Phanerozoic. Zenodo, doi:10.5281/zenodo.5460860. CC BY 4.0. Classes from Table 2 of Scotese, C.R., 2016, PALEOMAP PaleoAtlas for GPlates and the PaleoData Plotter Program, PALEOMAP Project.
